nations.name: Bay Mills Indian Community
nations.lands: the Bay Mills Reservation in Michigan

facts.text: The Community's published constitution records a ratification vote on October 8, 1936.

source.title: Constitution and Bylaws of the Bay Mills Indian Community

facts.text: The History Department dates the Community's first Tribal election to March 6, 1937.

source.title: History Department: Bay Mills Indian Community

facts.evidence: On March 6, 1937 we held our first tribal election

facts.text: Its constitution describes a General Tribal Council of qualified voters and an elected Executive Council exercising delegated powers.

source.title: Constitution and Bylaws of the Bay Mills Indian Community

facts.evidence: shall be composed of all qualified voters of the Community

facts.text: The History Department describes its mission as protecting culture, history and traditions for present and future generations.

source.title: History Department: Bay Mills Indian Community

facts.evidence: protect, manage and preserve our culture, history and traditions
